name: Stephen Stovell
headline: Senior Partner @ 7FC LLP | Cloud Transformation Specialist | ERP Solutions Expert | Leader in Innovation and Hybrid Ecosystems
about:
Partner at 7FC LLP, I bring over 15 years of ERP expertise to the table. My core specialty lies in ERP Functional Financials Consulting, where I’ve honed my skills to navigate the complex currents of ERP frameworks.

I’m an adept Project Manager, known for steering complex ERP projects to harbour, meeting budget and timeline targets consistently. My project management acumen encompasses strategic planning, risk navigation, and maintaining stakeholder relations. I pride myself on being a dynamic communicator, capable of marshalling cross-functional teams toward shared goals.

My experience extends to crafting solutions for intricate business challenges, particularly within the scope of Finance Transformation Programmes. My sectoral journey has traversed through diverse terrains including Hospitality, Retail, Aviation, Central Government, the NHS, Local Councils, Manufacturing, and the Charity sector.

My proficiency lies in both Technical and Functional aspects of Oracle Cloud ERP, as well as Data Migration. I’ve played a pivotal role in deploying RPA Solutions across multinational corporations in the UK and India.

Well-versed with Oracle Fusion/Cloud ERP, SAP, and D365 F&O, I'm also the co-proprietor of GRC & Estates Management Software Solutions, bringing forth innovations through iSite and Arctick.

Explore our ventures at:
- [Arctick GRC](https://www.arctick-grc.co.uk)
- [iSite](https://www.isite.co.uk)

As a business investor in the software arena, I’m on the lookout for fresh investment opportunities.

I’m a LION (LinkedIn Open Networker) and warmly welcome all connection requests.
… more

experiences.description:
At the helm of 7F Consultancy as a Senior Partner, I am the navigator for businesses embarking on the transformative odyssey of digital evolution. I bring a wealth of expertise in Oracle Cloud ERP, orchestrating project symphonies and steering the helm through the complex waters of Workstream Management. My forte lies in Functional Cloud ERP Financials, where I sculpt robust frameworks for financial success.

As a maestro of User Acceptance Testing, I ensure each digital piece performs to perfection. My sessions in Face-to-Face and Remote Training empower teams with the knowledge to thrive in new digital landscapes. I craft bespoke solutions with a craftsman's precision, ensuring every business need is not just met but exceeded.

When projects falter, I step in as the Recovery Expert, breathing life into troubled ventures and transforming financial operations. My domain knowledge spans the critical arteries of commerce - Procure to Pay (P2P), Order to Cash (O2C), and Record to Report (R2R), making me a Subject Matter Expert businesses rely on.

In the quest for digital mastery, I am your trusted ally, turning challenges into triumphs.
